frequency_question: How often does a proposed major industrial subsidy scheme reach formal gazette implementation within 36 months of initial policy articulation?
membership_rule: Central government ministry initiatives involving targeted financial outlays, credit guarantees, or capital subsidies for specific heavy manufacturing or automotive sectors in India, excluding routine annual budgetary allocations.

Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the universe of major comparable heavy automotive/EV manufacturing financial incentive schemes launched by the central government in the last decade.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller sub-component schemes or state-level policies.
skeleton: 3 major automotive/battery industrial support schemes evaluated for successful implementation within their targeted multi-year implementation windows.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 3 defined baseline episodes
validity_reason: Policy mechanisms for EV and green transition manufacturing remain structurally consistent under the current administrative framework through the decade.
